name: tabby-server-panel
description: A Tabby Terminal plugin providing a three-layer bottom panel for SSH sessions: server stats, quick commands, and file manager
// ANGULAR_VERSION_NOTE: @angular/compiler and @angular/compiler-cli are pinned to ^15.2.6 because @ngtools/webpack requires them as peer deps. @angular/core, @angular/common, @angular/forms are intentionally absent (type stubs in types/tabby.d.ts) to eliminate GHSA-58c5-g7wp-6w37, GHSA-prjf-86w9-mfqv. @angular/compiler remains required — @angular/compiler-cli ESM bundles import it at webpack run time (see README Security section). Its CVEs (GHSA-v4hv-rgfq-gp49, GHSA-jrmj-c5cx-3cw6) require SVG rendering of user-controlled content at browser runtime, which this plugin never does.
